text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Output of a solar plant equal to half the as-of capacity was added to the Primary's power in the scored year. Each dot is the share of the injected output that raising the forecast's capacity by that amount removes on the sunniest third of daylight half-hours (median over five real farms for the real-farm dots). Shaded band: the pre-registered pass band of 0.75 to 1.25.'
text.tspan: Output of a solar plant equal to half the as-of capacity was added to the Primary's power in the
scored year. Each dot is the share of the injected output that raising the forecast's capacity by
that amount removes on the sunniest third of daylight half-hours (median over five real farms for
the real-farm dots). Shaded band: the pre-registered pass band of 0.75 to 1.25.
